observations.behavior: Adds GithubResourceUnavailableError, GithubOrgNotFoundError, GithubAccessDeniedError, GithubRepositoryNotFoundError exceptions; GithubResourceUnavailableError is the parent of GithubOrgNotFoundError.
observations.posthog_connection: These exceptions distinguish GitHub API responses: 403 permission denial, 404 repository not found, and 404 org-scoped endpoints. GithubOrgNotFoundError is a subclass of GithubResourceUnavailableError, indicating an org-scoped 404. GithubAccessDeniedError and GithubRepositoryNotFoundError are separate, indicating permission and repository-specific issues.
